confirmation.label: Small heading of a card in the chat that shows a request waiting for someone's yes.
confirmation.confirm: Label of the button on a request card that gives the yes.
confirmation.refuse: Label of the button on a request card that says no.
confirmation.proof.title: Heading of the block on a request card where the person proves who they are.
confirmation.proof.passkey: Label of the button that starts the proof with a passkey.
confirmation.proof.password: Label of the field where the person types their password to prove who they are.
confirmation.proof.submit: Label of the button that sends the proof.
confirmation.changed: Line under a request card that tells the request was changed before it was carried out.
confirmation.nudged: Line under a request card that tells the one who asked reminded the person.
chat.key.frame_title: Accessible title of the frame that holds the secure form where the key is typed.
chat.key.action.rekey: Label of the button on a card that opens the form to type the key again.
chat.key.action.add: Label of the button on a card that opens the form to add a key.
chat.key.action.check: Label of the button on a card that checks that the server of the model answers.
chat.key.action.admin: Label of the button on a card that opens the form to type the admin key.
chat.key.waiting: Shown in the chat while the person has not yet typed the key in the form.
chat.key.checked: Shown in the chat once the new key was tested and the model answered.
account.title: Main title of the page where a person manages their own account.
account.display_name: Label of the line that shows the name of the person on their account page.
account.username: Label of the line that shows the sign-in name on the account page.
account.role: Label of the line that shows the role of the person in the household on the account page.
account.name.label: Label of the field where the person types their new name.
account.name.submit: Label of the button that saves the new name.
account.password.current: Label of the field where the person types the password they use now.
account.password.new: Label of the field where the person types the new password.
account.password.confirm: Label of the field where the person types the new password a second time.
account.password.submit: Label of the button that saves the new password.
account.passkeys.heading: Heading of the section of the account page about passkeys.
account.passkeys.remove: Label of the button that removes one passkey from the list.
account.passkeys.label: Label of the field where the person names the passkey they add.
account.passkeys.current: Label of the field where the person types their password before adding a passkey.
account.passkeys.submit: Label of the button that starts adding a passkey.
vault.form.title: Title of the secure page where a person types the key the assistant asked for, which goes straight into the vault. It asks for that one key and nothing else: never a password, a code or any other information.
vault.form.purpose: Label of the line that tells what the key is for (the line itself is written elsewhere).
vault.form.destinations: Label of the list of the only addresses the key will ever be sent to: the vault shows each address after it, as a host name, without words.
vault.form.value_label: Label of the one field of the secure page, where the person types the key. It asks for that one key and nothing else: never a password, a code or any other information.
vault.form.submit: Label of the button that saves the key in the vault.
vault.form.privacy: Shown on the secure page where the person types a key: what becomes of the key. It asks for that one key and nothing else: never a password, a code or any other information.
vault.form.error.length: Shown on the secure page when the key typed is empty or too long: {max} is the most characters a key may have. It asks for that one key and nothing else: never a password, a code or any other information.
vault.form.error.invalid: Shown on the secure page when the key typed holds characters that cannot be kept. It asks for that one key and nothing else: never a password, a code or any other information.
action.card.done.note.show: The card under the assistant's reply that shows the person the exact words someone wrote when they left a note for them, exactly as they were typed. {name} is who wrote them; {when} is the date and time they were written; {words} is filled by the code with those words, which may run over several lines: keep it as it is, after the rest of the sentence.
action.card.done.note.show.noted: The card under the assistant's reply that shows the person a note someone left for them when their exact words were not kept: it must say plainly that these are not the author's own words but what the assistant noted. {name} is who left the note; {when} is when; {words} is filled by the code with what the assistant noted, which may run over several lines: keep it as it is, after the rest of the sentence.
action.card.done.note.show.his: The card under the assistant's reply that shows the person a note the assistant left them himself, in his own name: the words are his own. {when} is when he wrote it; {words} is filled by the code with his words, which may run over several lines: keep it as it is, after the rest of the sentence.
chat.key.new.kind: Label of the list where the person chooses the provider of a new key of their own.
chat.key.new.base_url_hint: Help under the field of a server's address: {local} and {remote} are two example addresses.
chat.key.new.has_key: Label of the box the person ticks when their own server needs an API key.
chat.key.new.submit: Label of the button that sends the choice of the provider of a new key.
chat.key.new.checking: Shown under the form of a new key while the assistant checks that the model answers.
chat.key.new.name.title: Heading of the question asked when the server of a new key does not list its models.
chat.key.new.name.submit: Label of the button that sends the name of the model the server serves.
chat.key.secret_purpose: What the secure form of the vault says the key typed in it is for.

audit.line.other: A line of the audit log for something done that has no line of its own yet.

manifest.description: One-line description of the assistant that a phone shows when the page is installed as an app.
action.describe.texts.language: {language} is a language tag, such as es, fr or pt-BR.

chat.author.assistant: Accessible label of a bubble of the assistant in the chat; {domo} is the name the reader calls the assistant by (the assistant unless they gave him another).
chat.input.placeholder: Placeholder of the message box of the chat; {domo} is the name the reader calls the assistant by (the assistant unless they gave him another).
chat.status.writing: Line for screen readers while a reply is being written; {domo} is the name the reader calls the assistant by.
chat.actions.label: Accessible label of the cards of what the assistant did under a reply; {domo} is the name the reader calls the assistant by.
